sql: select case when created_at < now() - interval $$90 days$$ then $$a_older_90d$$ when created_at < now() - interval $$60 days$$ then $$b_60_90d$$ when created_at < now() - interval $$30 days$$ then $$c_30_60d$$ else $$d_under_30d$$ end as opened, count(*) as open_trades, count(distinct market_ticker) as tickers, min(created_at)::date as oldest, string_agg(distinct split_part(market_ticker,$$-$$,1), $$,$$) filter (where created_at < now() - interval $$60 days$$) as series_over_60d from paper_trades where closed_at is null and status not in ($$closed$$,$$settled$$,$$cancelled$$,$$canceled$$) group by 1 order by 1
